code.method: hidden executable behavioral checks; report all case results and failures, no semantic quality average

offline-design.mechanism: 0: timestamp/whole-row overwrite or wishlist. 1: partial field/version approach. 2: concrete field/operation reconciliation with server CAS and a meaningful comparator.
offline-design.authority_and_data: 0: loses tenant/accepted-edit or photo constraints. 1: acknowledges some. 2: preserves tenant authority, accepted edit durability, conflict visibility and metered photo separation.
offline-design.failure_and_recovery: 0: happy path only. 1: partial. 2: handles duplicate/reordered retry, conflicting offline edits and recovery without unsupported infrastructure.
offline-design.experiment: 0: no falsifier or fabricated run. 1: vague test. 2: bounded reproducible initial states/interleaving, observations for support/rejection and cleanup/limits.
offline-design.decision_and_slice: 0: no decisive assumption/slice. 1: incomplete. 2: names an uncertain design assumption, rejection-driven alternative and real first slice without inventing research.

replan.evidence_update: 0: keeps H1/P1 as primary. 1: partial retraction. 2: explicitly retracts stale-cache explanation for replay and P1 as supported fix, preserving production uncertainty.
replan.causal_impact: 0: misses early success event. 1: identifies but incomplete path. 2: enqueue event -> UI final state -> unfinished/missing object with relevant failure/recovery.
replan.compatible_repair: 0: blindly redefines export.success or adds unrelated platform. 1: vague compatibility. 2: separate final completion/consumer handling while billing acceptance remains compatible.
replan.experiment: 0: none/fabricated. 1: partial. 2: concrete held worker/failure/duplicate/reorder checks, terminal result and rejecting observation with bounded conditions.
replan.proof_and_scope: 0: claims production proven or changes schedule. 1: incomplete boundaries. 2: preserves anchor, reuses only relevant snapshot evidence, names missing image/queue proof and avoids unauthorized actions.

critical_failures: tenant or accepted-edit data loss presented as acceptable
production proof claimed from local replay
limits: One observation per model/task/condition. Coordinator-authored criteria, condition-masked scoring, not independent. No statistical significance claim.
